Rainbow Robotics and Miracom partner to connect MES with factory robots

The partnership combines robot hardware and manufacturing systems, covering site analysis, application design, installation and operations.

RobotsBeat ↗18 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Combining manufacturing software and robots

Miracom, a Samsung SDS subsidiary, and Rainbow Robotics signed a partnership on November 17 and disclosed it on November 18. They plan to deliver robot adoption as part of a connected manufacturing operation, extending the service beyond the supply of machines.

Responsibilities across the deployment lifecycle

Rainbow Robotics will provide suitable robots and related technology. Miracom will handle customer development, site analysis, application design, MES and factory-system integration, installation and operations. Joint service development will combine data, AI and robotics so that task decisions can reflect the actual state of production.

Existing customers are not new robot orders

Miracom cites 28 years of digital-factory work for more than 430 manufacturers. That describes its existing experience, not new robot installations under this agreement. The announcement gives no contract value, robot quantity or delivery schedule; actual customer projects will establish the scale of the partnership.
